The game screen initially shows an equipment shop interface filled with colorful icons for weapons and armor. (2) The scene cuts to active gameplay on a digital battlefield with green grass and stone paths. A female-style character with white hair and green visual effects moves across the screen using skills. Blue and red damage numbers and health bars appear above characters as they clash in combat. (3) A series of fast-paced combat highlights follows, showing various skill combinations and character movements. Bright blue and purple particle effects dominate the screen during big battles. The gamer in the top-right window reacts with expressive facial movements and enthusiastic speech as the game progresses.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male voice speaking rapidly in Mandarin, accompanied by a steady, upbeat electronic beat. Sharp 'click' sounds from the game's menu navigation punctuate the narration as he explains the equipment. The BGM provides a rhythmic foundation with synthesized pads and a driving percussion section. (2) As the gameplay intensifies, the voice pitch rises with excitement, and several 'whoosh' sound effects are introduced as skills are cast. Loud 'thud' and 'shimmering' sounds represent hits and critical damage within the game mix. The narrator's speech becomes even denser, matching the fast pace of the on-screen action. (3) The final phase features a collage of battle sounds, including metallic clashes and magical energy bursts. The narrator's tone remains humorous and confident, with occasional laughter. High-frequency digital UI 'pings' sound as the player gains gold or levels up, while the EDM track continues without interruption until the end.
